description: A single destination within a [v-nav-rail](/components/nav-rails), rendering an icon button with a label below it.

props.title: The label shown beneath the icon.
props.icon: The icon shown for the inactive (and default) state.
props.activeIcon: The icon shown when the item is selected. Falls back to `icon` when not provided.
props.divider: Renders a horizontal divider after the item.
props.verticalDivider: Renders a vertical divider after the item.
